Author: t3sco (based on Mappy by MidoriKami, harbingerftw)
Name: Gratis
Description: Replaces the in-game map with a flat, minimal ImGui map: search, lenses, filters, travel offers, window presets and dozens of small QoL tweaks. Based on Mappy by MidoriKami and harbingerftw. Open with /gratis.
Changelog: Lighter on your frame time, and sorry for the update spam. Typical frame in a busy hub about 0.55 ms to about 0.28 ms, hovering a marker no longer costs extra, much less garbage per frame, no stall when changing big maps, and a new /gratis perf command.
